# Evidence and Completion

Before using a success label, compare every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Report files changed, commands and results, security review status, operational and cost impact, unverified items, residual risk, and rollback. Static inspection is not runtime proof; a generated narrative is not evidence.

Use `COMPLETE_VERIFIED` only when the required checks actually support it. Otherwise use `IMPLEMENTATION_PREPARED_NOT_VERIFIED`, `CHANGES_REQUIRED`, `BLOCKED_ON_HUMAN_DECISION`, or `NOT_VERIFIED` and state the missing evidence.
